mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (as a continuous variable) are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as reduced risk-free rates increase the present value of equity cash flows.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals an economic recession that increases risk aversion and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and the federal funds rate is at or below 0.5%, the economy is in a deep recession with ultra-loose monetary policy, triggering a market bottom and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 215), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an impending recession that triggers a market rebound due to expected monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 215 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600,000 units signals a weakening real estate market that increases risk aversion and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 600.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns, such that lower housing starts predict negative returns over the next 20 trading days, as declining real estate activity signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (as a continuous variable) are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as reduced risk-free rates increase the present value of equity cash flows in the short term.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of real sales (RSAFS) is positively related to S&P 500 forward returns, such that higher real sales predict positive returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong consumer spending supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Rank IC between RSAFS and 60-day forward returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
